column1: # HK-47 pack wiring, decided with Master. One row per output clip.
# Build rule (set 2026-09-09): every clip is qualifier-first. The spoken
# qualifier segment leads, the source's own pause follows, then the sentence.
# cut     keep a single span A-B
# splice  join span A-B to span C-D, restoring a pause between them
# graft   join a span from ANOTHER clip to a span of this one (rule exception)
# In a span list, ~D is D seconds of explicit silence rather than audio, for
# where a word is excised and neither the source's own pause nor the 0.45s
# fallback is the right length. Fence it with | on both sides: A-B|~0.30|C-D.
